layers.label: Dark Aether — Zarqwa Hydroelectric
layers.note: Repeat-visit map. Complete all three contracts before the optional Gyanxi sequence. Destroy the three outer spores before the central Rift Heart; both ordinary and Elder visits can award Smoke Signals.

targets.description: Destroy west/north/east spores in any order, then the central Rift Heart. This is not a Spore Control contract.
